يعتصمن (form VIII)
# يَعْتَصِمْنَ (yaʕtaṣimna) /jaʕ.ta.sˤim.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# يُعْتَصَمْنَ (yuʕtaṣamna) /juʕ.ta.sˤam.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
